events.title: Zhu Wen has Emperor Zhaozong of Tang murdered
events.description: The warlord Zhu Wen, who had seized control of the imperial government and moved Emperor Zhaozong to Luoyang, had him murdered. Zhaozong was the penultimate Tang emperor; Zhu Wen ended the dynasty in 907, founding the Later Liang.

events.title: Samogitians and Semigallians defeat the Sword Brethren at Saule
events.description: Near modern Šiauliai in northern Lithuania, Samogitian and Semigallian forces destroyed an army of the Livonian Brothers of the Sword returning from a raid, killing the order's master Volkwin. The broken order was merged into the Teutonic Order the next year.

events.title: Aragonese cavalry rout a Castilian force at Araviana
events.description: In the War of the Two Peters, eight hundred Aragonese horsemen, many of them Castilian exiles under Henry of Trastámara, routed a Castilian frontier force near Ágreda. Its commander, Juan Fernández de Henestrosa, and numerous Castilian nobles and knights were killed.

events.title: Treaty of Basel ends the Swabian War
events.description: Emperor Maximilian I made peace with the Swiss Confederation after its victories in the Swabian War. The Swiss became independent of the Empire in practice; formal recognition came in 1648.

events.title: The last executions of the Salem witch trials take place
events.description: Martha Corey, Mary Eastey, Alice Parker, Mary Parker, Ann Pudeator, Wilmot Redd, Margaret Scott and Samuel Wardwell were hanged for witchcraft, the last executions of the Salem witch trials. Nineteen were hanged in all before Governor William Phips halted the trials.

events.title: The British hang Nathan Hale as a spy
events.description: Captured behind British lines on Long Island, 21-year-old Captain Nathan Hale was hanged in Manhattan. He is said to have regretted that he had 'but one life to lose for my country'.

events.title: Lincoln issues the preliminary Emancipation Proclamation
events.description: Lincoln announced that enslaved people in states still in rebellion on 1 January 1863 would be declared free. The war for the Union became also a war against slavery.

events.title: Iraq invades Iran
events.description: Saddam Hussein's forces invaded Iran, starting an eight-year war of trenches, missile attacks and poison gas. Hundreds of thousands died before a ceasefire in 1988 left borders unchanged.
